relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Daughter and student; he orders her to capture Okuma alone.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Disciple he teaches despite Kuraudo's violent nature, later pushing him to adapt Ayatsuji swordsmanship to his own brutality.
relationships.ginji-okuma: Old criminal he defeated and forgot, triggering Okuma's revenge attempt.

periods.summary: Kaito is targeted by escaped prisoner Ginji Okuma, a former yakuza Blazer whom he defeated fifteen years earlier and does not remember. He uses the situation to test Ayase, trusting her to capture the intruder. A later flashback shows Kaito visiting Kuraudo after the Seven Stars Festival and warning him not to become a mere Ayatsuji swordsman: Kuraudo should use Ayatsuji techniques as tools and pour his original violence into them, creating his own Ten'i Muhou.

key_events.summary: Lets Ayase handle Okuma rather than intervening.
His post-Seven-Stars advice explains Kuraudo's new fiery form of Ten'i Muhou.
